title: Quadrilaterals and Their Properties
introduction: Build Primary 4 mathematical understanding through quadrilaterals and their properties.
definition: A quadrilateral is a polygon with four sides. Rectangles have four right angles; squares also have four equal sides. A parallelogram has two pairs of parallel opposite sides; a rhombus has four equal sides. The interior angles sum to 360°.

formulas.description: Interior angle sum of a simple quadrilateral.

examples.question: A quadrilateral has angles 90°, 90° and 110°. Find the fourth.
A parallelogram has one side 7 cm and an adjacent side 4 cm.

exercises.question: How many right angles does a rectangle have?
exercises.solution: All its corners are right angles.

exercises.question: A quadrilateral has four equal sides and no right angles. Name it.
exercises.solution: Four equal sides define a rhombus.

exercises.question: How many pairs of parallel sides does a parallelogram have?
